stem:
[Image: a cube for Figure A and a square-base pyramid for Figure B.]
Here are some statements about Figure A and Figure B. Put an X to show whether each statement is true or false.

| Statement | True | False |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A and B both have a square face. | X | |
| A and B both have the same number of faces. | | |
| All the angles in A are right angles. | | |
| B has more edges than A. | | |
| Some of the edges in B are curved. | | |

descriptors:
Puts the X's in the correct column as shown below.
[Image: table with two columns and five rows. Columns are “True” and “False”. First row is an x, printed in, under true. Second row is an x, drawn in, under false. Third row is an x, drawn in under true. Fourth and fifth rows are an x, drawn in, under false.]

figure_description: Two 3-D geometric figures are shown side by side, with hidden edges represented by dashed lines. On the left, labeled 'Figure A', is a cube. On the right, labeled 'Figure B', is a square-based pyramid standing on its square base with four triangular faces meeting at a top vertex.
